notes.sowing: Start indoors 5 to 7 weeks before planting out, {cm:0.6} deep, growing seedlings at {c:16} to {c:21}. Set plants out 1 to 3 weeks before your last frost. For a fall crop, sow 12 to 14 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Water evenly: a heavy soaking after dry weather splits mature heads. Heat above about {c:27} slows growth and can cause tipburn inside the head. Avoid ground where cabbage-family crops grew recently.
notes.harvest: Cut when heads are firm and full size, just above the outer leaves. If rain threatens to split a ready head, twist it a quarter turn to break some of the roots.
